Title: Pull an Image
Description: Use the Docker CLI to pull the latest "nginx" image from Docker Hub.

Title: Run a Container
Description: Run a container named "webserver" using the "nginx" image in detached mode.

Title: List Running Containers
Description: List all currently running containers using the Docker command.

Title: Remove a Container
Description: Remove the container named "webserver" from your system.

Title: Inspect an Image
Description: Inspect the "nginx" image to view its metadata and configuration details.

Title: View Container Logs
Description: Display the logs of a running container named "webserver".

Title: Copy File to Container
Description: Copy a local file named "index.html" into the "/usr/share/nginx/html" directory of the "webserver" container.

Title: Build a Docker Image
Description: Build a Docker image named "custom-ubuntu" using the Dockerfile created in the current directory.
